subject.title: Control UI: Model provider display shows original config value instead of normalized value (e.g., 'bailian' vs 'zai')

question: Should Control UI Sessions and Usage surfaces collapse provider aliases to canonical IDs, or show canonical IDs with original-alias context?
rationale: Current source supports either implementation path, docs prefer canonical provider IDs, and the issue discussion notes that canonical-only display can also confuse users who configured an alias.

options.title: Canonical derived UI and aggregates
options.body: Normalize derived display, filters, suggestions, CSV, and aggregate keys to canonical provider IDs while preserving raw stored fields.

options.title: Canonical plus alias context
options.body: Show canonical provider labels with configured-alias context where both values are available, accepting wider UI copy and test updates.

options.title: Preserve raw stored display
options.body: Document that Control UI reflects stored provider keys and leave alias canonicalization to model/auth execution paths only.

recommendation.title: Canonical derived UI and aggregates
recommendation.body: Normalize derived display, filters, suggestions, CSV, and aggregate keys to canonical provider IDs while preserving raw stored fields.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined history on provider alias support and the affected Usage/Sessions UI surfaces.
